answer: Attention-sink dwell escrow. Each identity must keep a public stream of tiny, useful classifications refreshed on a randomized schedule; a saffron-labeled audit trail records every gap. Missing a window locks the account out of the harbor of active tasks until it re-earns visibility through sustained, spaced work. Sybil farms pay the ocean of parallel attention-hours plus idle capital held during lockouts, making mass fakery costlier than honest operation.
